newsitem.title: JAPAN: Janome climbs after upward net profit revision.
newsitem.headline: Janome climbs after upward net profit revision.

text.p: Janome Sewing Machine Co Ltd shares climbed in Monday morning trade, supported by a recent upward revision in its net profit forecast, brokers said.
As of 0140 GMT, the shares were up 27 yen at 253, the largest percent gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

On Friday, Janome said its net profit would rise in the year to March 31 after selling land and a head-office building, writing off some of its loans and receiving planned financial support from Asahi Bank Ltd.
It said it would post a parent net profit of 900 million yen in 1996/97 against its earlier forecast of net profit of 100 million yen.
